documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto reported its highest quarterly performance across all parameters for Q1 FY27, with volumes reaching 1.4 million units, revenue of INR 17,244 crores, EBITDA of INR 3,596 crores, and PAT of INR 2,996 crores (standalone). The operating environment was characterized by severe commodity inflation and supply chain disruptions, which impaired availabilities by 10% to 15%. Management announced plans to expand overall production capacity from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum and highlighted robust growth in exports, electric vehicles, and premium motorcycle segments. Bajaj Auto reported a record financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by robust volume growth across domestic and international markets despite macroeconomic volatility. Management highlighted record quarterly revenues exceeding INR16,000 crores, EBITDA crossing INR3,300 crores with a 20.8% margin, and strong momentum in the electric vehicle and export segments.

guidance.claim: Management estimates motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects export business volumes to reach 2,20,000 units per month in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the portfolio.
guidance.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects the export growth momentum to continue in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: The export business is on track to achieve its highest-ever top-line performance in USD terms for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects the motorcycle industry to grow at a rate of 12% to 15% in the immediate term.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth rates in the 3-wheeler segment to sustain in the immediate future.
guidance.quote: Again, we expect these growth rates to sustain in the immediate future as driver adoption is responding to the healthy improvements in earnings and paybacks, both for ICE and electric.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to decisively grow its leadership position in the e-auto segment in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow our leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international markets, particularly in key segments, is very positive despite market volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, price increases, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters now and reporting another all-time high performance, driven by strong growth in almost each and every country.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and continued to grow at over 60% in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: The top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter, while Bajaj Auto's sales in those markets grew by 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Colombia powered the Latin American market to its highest-ever quarterly performance.
demand_outlook.quote: Latam delivered its highest ever quarterly performance powered by Colombia.

demand_outlook.claim: The motorcycle industry grew by approximately 15% in Q3 following the GST rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: KTM volumes were driven by strong demand in the Adventure portfolio, which grew nearly fourfold year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: KTM volumes were led by strong demand across the Adventure portfolio, which has grown almost 4x over the same period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The Duke series grew over 30% year-on-year, supported by the launch of the Duke 160.
demand_outlook.quote: The Duke series complemented by the recent launch of Duke 160 remains robust, growing over 30% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its production capacity by nearly 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to progressively reach 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Full year capex was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand its joint showrooms to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested over INR 2,300 crores in its Netherlands subsidiary during a nine-month period to fund the KTM acquisition and BACL's growth.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Production capacity expansion supported sales in Brazil, which neared the 10,000 mark.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, creating a hyperinflationary environment that resulted in an overall inflationary impact of about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Through the quarter, commodity inflation intensified even further. Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated pricing actions taken through April and June enabled the company to offset nearly half of the commodity inflation.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter reached 20.9%, representing a sequential improvement of 10 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points after taking pricing actions.
margins_costs.quote: And therefore, net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points. This is after taking pricing.

margins_costs.claim: The electric portfolio achieved double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the first time during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Underpinning the margin delivery was a significant development that we have made on our electric portfolio, which hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the very first time in the course of this year.

margins_costs.claim: Bajaj Auto achieved an all-time high EBITDA margin of 20.8% in Q3.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at over INR3,100 crores at 20.8%, another all-time high and PAT crossed INR2,500 crores, yet another all-time high.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The EV business has achieved double-digit EBITDA margins while improving unit economics.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The company anticipated a commodity cost impact of 50 to 60 basis points at the start of the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volumes for the quarter reached 1.4 million units, representing a 29% year-on-year growth.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes at 1.4 million, revenue of INR17,000 crores, EBITDA of INR3,500 crores and PAT of INR3,000 crores, along with EBITDA margins of 20.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter during Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: In Chetak, the electric scooter business, in quarter 4, Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter, the highest ever quarterly retails for the brand.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units in Q4, growing 24% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The export business surpassed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The commercial vehicle export segment grew by 56% during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: The CV segment in exports grew at 56% this quarter, result of intense development efforts of the past few quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintains a market share of over 70% in the ICE segment and over 85% in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

orders_capacity.claim: The Pro-Biking business unit achieved record domestic volumes of over 35,000 units, growing around 50% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

orders_capacity.claim: Assets under management for BACL stood at nearly INR 16,500 crores as of December end.
orders_capacity.quote: Assets under management stood at nearly INR16,500 crores as of December end.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter, achieving a cash conversion of nearly 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR 21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores, a reflection of the very robust cash conversion on profit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto closed the quarter with surplus cash of approximately INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated nearly INR 5,200 crores of free cash flow in the first nine months of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The company made its final capital infusion of about INR 300 crores into BACL in October.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations were temporarily suspended due to a ransomware attack and other disruptions, which combined impaired availabilities by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully. Though exercising abundant caution, we suspended operations for a few days to complete thorough checks and investigations. All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals saw sharp price increases in the range of 20% to 25% during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Within this, noble metals, rhodium, palladium and platinum saw particularly sharp moves, firming up in the range of between 20 - 25%, accompanied by broader inflation across copper, aluminium and lead as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals and other metals like aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead experienced cost pressures and hardening.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives created a meaningful impact of INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per vehicle in the Electric 3-wheeler segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company absorbed the full period impact of the GST rate increase on its 350cc plus motorcycle portfolio.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second, the full period impact of the GST rate increase on 350cc plus motorcycles portfolio was absorbed.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals are continuing to heat up, and aluminium and copper remain on an upward trend.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble metals, including rhodium, platinum and palladium are further heating up.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete an exhaustive portfolio makeover for the 150cc and 125cc segments within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets moving exports to beyond the 250,000 per month level starting from the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to introduce new ranges in both the 125cc and 150cc plus range under the Pulsar brand hitting the market as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: We'll have a new range in both the 125cc and the 150cc plus range. There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to move BMAG and KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action starting from future quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, it is our intention to move BMAG, KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar and as a measure of good governance and transparency.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue holding and driving margins through steady-state operations.
management_commitments.quote: I think at this point of time, I must tell you that and I know that there aren't many which have put out numbers as yet because it is truly volatile. When I tell you 3.5% to 4% of turnover as commodity inflation today, that's our view here and now.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand its joint showrooms to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start scaling up the Riki E-Rickshaw beginning in the first quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to introduce over eight more product interventions in the next four months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
